subject.title: feat(plugins): add exact-profile provider usage reads

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose exact auth-profile provider-usage reads to trusted plugins through `runtime.providerUsage.read`, and if so what stable authorization and compatibility contract should it carry?
rationale: The patch creates a public plugin SDK capability across auth-profile selection and provider usage; choosing whether that capability belongs in the shared runtime cannot be safely inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Approve a narrow SDK seam
options.body: Accept the exact-profile read-only API after documenting its ownership, supported callers, and compatibility expectations, then require live provider proof.

options.title: Keep usage reads provider-local
options.body: Decline the shared runtime API and have the consuming provider/plugin own the behavior through an existing supported seam.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Pause the PR until a maintainer specifies the intended plugin API and profile-access policy.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow SDK seam
recommendation.body: Accept the exact-profile read-only API after documenting its ownership, supported callers, and compatibility expectations, then require live provider proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate for a core plugin-runtime API decision.
